description: This file defines the VacancyAttachmentModel class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It represents a model for vacancy attachment data used in the API, including serialization and normalizable features, and integrates a DTO for recruitment attachment details.

classes.name: VacancyAttachmentModel
classes.description: A model class for vacancy attachments used in the recruitment API, providing serialization support and mapping data from a RecruitmentAttachment DTO.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the VacancyAttachmentModel with a RecruitmentAttachment DTO, setting up filters and attribute mappings for API serialization.
